Australia hit EV tipping point as BYD confirms; EV sales outpaced petrol cars for first time
Bathla collapse flagged as systemic warning for construction sector and broader 'Ponzi economy' concerns
ASIC launched review of whistleblower complaints at Big Four accounting firms

CBA and Westpac flagged for charging loyal customers more via legal loopholes
Australia's per-capita economy stalling while Canada's soars, raising structural competitiveness concerns

sectors.trend: Iron ore shakeout underway amid geopolitical distraction; small-cap explorers (Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche, Aurum, Brightstar, Solstice, Power Minerals) showing relative strength
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face margin pressure from demand softness; small-cap gold and critical-mines names offer diversification but carry elevated volatility

sectors.trend: Rate-sensitive pressure on banks; CBA and Westpac under scrutiny for customer pricing practices; ASIC review of accounting firms adds regulatory overhang
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX face margin pressure from rate expectations and reputational risk; defensive positioning warranted

sectors.trend: EV adoption crossed tipping point in Australia; BYD confirms structural shift; hidden costs (infrastructure, grid) emerging
sectors.implications: Consumer staples (WES.AX, WBC.AX) benefit from fuel-cost savings; auto and energy infrastructure names gain; traditional fuel retailers face structural decline

sectors.trend: Bathla collapse signals sector-wide fragility; housing construction expected to follow falling prices; Brisbane waterfront approval lacks affordable housing
sectors.implications: Construction and property-linked REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face demand contraction; credit risk in construction supply chain elevated

sectors.trend: El Nino-driven cyclone risk in Qld; bushfires active; grid strain from EV adoption; Star (SGH.AX) under Worksafe review
sectors.implications: Energy names (SME.AX, AGL.AX, CGP.AX) face operational and regulatory risk; insurance and infrastructure demand may rise

sectors.trend: Defence drones disrupting traditional procurement; skilled migration prioritising AI workers; vaccine and pharma names active globally
sectors.implications: Defence (DWI.AX, REO.AX) and tech/AI-adjacent names gain policy tailwind; CSL.AX remains defensive anchor

risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds and dividend-paying defensives; reduce leverage in rate-sensitive REITs and construction
Diversify away from pure iron ore exposure; favour gold (AUG.AX) and critical-mines small caps
Avoid construction-linked credit exposure; monitor SGH.AX and property developers closely
Maintain 10-15% cash allocation; hold gold and energy hedges
Monitor CBA.AX, WBC.AX, SGH.AX for disclosure events; reduce concentration in flagged names
Consider international diversification; monitor NOM and productivity data

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and critical-mines small caps as iron ore weakens
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore shakeout creates relative value in gold (Aurum) and strategic minerals (Vanadium, Power Minerals, Piche)

opportunities.recommendation: Position for EV infrastructure and grid upgrade beneficiaries
opportunities.rationale: EV tipping point confirmed; hidden infrastructure costs create multi-year capex cycle for utilities and grid operators

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive healthcare and dividend staples
opportunities.rationale: Rate uncertainty and economic stall favour income-oriented, low-beta names

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to construction and property-linked credit
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla collapse signals sector-wide fragility; housing construction to follow prices lower

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim pure iron ore large-cap exposure pending demand clarity
defensive_moves.rationale: Structural shakeout in iron ore masked by geopolitical noise; margin compression likely

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash buffer and gold hedge amid geopolitical and rate uncertainty
defensive_moves.rationale: Multiple concurrent risks (US-Iran, El Nino, RBA path) elevate tail risk

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in September (historically weak month) amid RBA rate concerns and iron ore softness. Volatility elevated by geopolitical headlines. Small-cap miners may outperform on relative value. Expect range-bound trading with downside bias until rate path clarifies.
market_outlook.long_term: Bull case is returning but structural headwinds (stalling per-capita growth, construction fragility, EV transition costs) cap upside. Diversification into critical minerals, EV infrastructure, and healthcare offers medium-term growth. Iron ore normalisation to lower equilibrium is a multi-year theme.
